> chain (Portfolio → Tenant → Business → Workspace) is different. Corrections belong
> in a V2 document that cites this file, never in this file. Cite its ids with a

Write vitest cases for src/lib/ai/nl2sql/gates.js exported validators.
Each case: const r = runGates(sql); expect(r.ok).toBe(false) and expect(r.reason).toMatch(...)
Required cases:
1. "WITH d AS (DELETE FROM customers RETURNING *) SELECT * FROM d" -> rejected
2. "SELECT tenantId, name FROM customers" (no WHERE tenantId =) -> rejected
3. "SELECT name FROM customers WHERE tenantId = $1 LIMIT 10" -> pass
4. "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE tenantId = $1" -> pass
5. "SELECT 1; DROP TABLE x" -> rejected (multi-statement)
6. "SELECT /*DELETE*/ name FROM c WHERE tenantId = $1" -> pass (comment is not DML)
